text: DSH Theme Palette 为 DSH Web 界面提供可视化主题配色选择。它在“设置 → 常规”中加入配色行，用户可预览并选择默认、海洋、森林、余烬、紫罗兰、玫瑰、沙丘、黑曜石或赛博朋克配色。选择会覆盖界面颜色令牌，并保留现有浅色、深色或跟随系统的外观设置；偏好保存在插件配置中。赛博朋克配色还会显示霓虹背景与自定义品牌标记，适合希望调整 DSH Web 外观的人使用。

DSH Theme Palette adds a picker to Settings → General in the DSH Web UI. Choose among nine palettes, preview the colors, and retain the active light, dark, or system appearance setting. The choice is saved in plugin configuration. Cyberpunk also adds a neon backdrop and custom brand mark.
想给 DSH 网页界面换一套整体配色。
能不能在设置里预览并切换不同颜色主题？
I want a custom color palette in the DSH Web UI that keeps working with light and dark mode.
DSH Theme Palette 的功能「切换主题配色」：在“设置 → 常规”提供配色预览按钮。点击后立即覆盖界面颜色令牌，并将选择写入插件配置；默认选项可移除覆盖层。
DSH Theme Palette 的功能「赛博朋克外观」：选择 Cyberpunk 配色时添加霓虹网格背景，并将自定义品牌图标显示在侧栏和会话首页标记位；切换其他配色或卸载时清理这些界面元素。

@local/dsh-theme-palette README · Theme palette：Adds a **Theme palette** row to Settings → General in the DSH Web UI. A palette
recolors the interface (surfaces, borders, text, sidebar, menus, code blocks,
links, and focus ring) while the shipped **Appearance** row keeps deciding
light / dark / system.

@local/dsh-theme-palette README · Theme palette：| Palette | Character |
| --- | --- |
| Default | The built-in untinted look |
| Ocean | Cool blue |
| Forest | Deep green |
| Ember | Warm orange |
| Violet | Purple |
| Rose | Pink-red |
| Sand | Warm neutral |
| Obsidian | Neutral near-black with a violet accent, after the Obsidian editor theme |
| Cyberpunk | Neon HUD: translucent panels over a glowing grid backdrop, cyan/magenta accents, and a custom gradient brand mark |

@local/dsh-theme-palette README · Cyberpunk：The Cyberpunk palette is the complex one. Besides its token set it owns two
extra pieces that appear only while it is selected:

@local/dsh-theme-palette README · Cyberpunk：- **Backdrop** — a plugin-owned stylesheet paints two pointer-transparent
  pseudo-elements (`body::before`/`body::after`): a neon horizon of cyan,
  violet, and magenta glows, a 44px HUD grid with scanlines, and a soft vignette
  mask. Its surface tokens are translucent, so panels float over it. A pale
  daylight variant is used while Appearance is in light mode. Removing the
  palette removes the stylesheet.
- **Brand mark** — an original SVG emblem (gradient hex, diamond core, HUD ticks,
  cyan glow) replaces `sidebar.brand.mark` and fills
  `conversation.hero.brand.mark`. The sidebar mark is a single slot whose shipped
  occupant sits at priority 0, so the mark registers at priority −1 to shadow it
  and disposes when another palette is selected, restoring the shipped mark.

@local/dsh-theme-palette README · How it works：- `client.js` registers one `settings.general.item` row (order 11.5, next to
  Appearance and font size) with a swatch preview per palette.
- Choosing a palette stacks a `ctx.theme.overrideTokens()` layer of
  `--dsw-*` alias tokens over the active light/dark theme. Each palette carries
  the same token set for both color schemes, so Appearance keeps working.
- The choice is stored in this plugin's Host config (`palette`, a volatile
  text field), read and written with `ctx.configForms.get('theme-palette')`.
  It survives restarts, and a refused write reverts the row.

@local/dsh-theme-palette README · Install：In the DSH Web UI, open **Plugins → Add plugin**, paste the absolute path to
this directory, install, then switch the bundle on. The row appears in
**Settings → General**, directly under Appearance.

From the Desktop CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-theme-palette
```

Because a local directory installs as a `link:`, edits to the client half apply
after a page reload without reinstalling.

@local/dsh-theme-palette README · Vendored dependencies：`vendor/schemastery.mjs` and `vendor/cosmokit.mjs` are the Harness's own
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 3.19.0 and `@deepseek-ai/cosmokit` 1.9.0 builds.
Both are MIT: see `vendor/LICENSE-schemastery` (DeepSeek) and
`vendor/LICENSE-cosmokit` (Shigma, 2021-present). A profile-installed bundle
cannot resolve the Harness installation's packages, so the Host half needs a
local copy to declare its `Config` schema. Volatile config references are
identified with `Symbol.for`, so these copies interoperate with the Host's
settings service.
